idea-plugin.name: Kassi Security Inspections for WordPress
idea-plugin.description:
Static security inspections for WordPress plugin and theme code, right in PhpStorm. Each rule maps to a CWE and is backed by real, fixed CVEs from the WordPress plugin ecosystem. For every rule, the vulnerable code is flagged and the fixed code stays silent.

Inspections

  • WP-001 AJAX / admin-post handler changes state without a capability check (CWE-862)
  • WP-002 AJAX / admin-post handler changes state without nonce verification (CWE-352)
  • WP-003 Privileged action in a wp_ajax_nopriv_* / admin_post_nopriv_* handler (CWE-862)
  • WP-004 REST route without a real permission_callback (CWE-862)
  • WP-005 SQL built from request data without $wpdb->prepare() (CWE-89)
  • WP-006 Request data output without escaping (CWE-79)
  • WP-007 File path built from request data (CWE-22)
  • WP-008 wp_redirect() to a URL from request data (CWE-601)
  • WP-009 PHP object injection via unserialize() of request data (CWE-502)
  • WP-010 Server-side request forgery via wp_remote_*() (CWE-918)
  • WP-011 Uploaded file stored without a file type check (CWE-434)
  • WP-012 Request data decides a user role or capabilities (CWE-269)
  • WP-013 Shortcode attributes output without escaping, i.e. stored XSS (CWE-79)

Built for precision

  • Follows request data through assignments, concatenation, interpolation, branches and loops within a function, and stays silent when a flow is not proven.
  • Recognises the WordPress defences: esc_*, wp_kses*, prepare(), current_user_can(), nonces, wp_safe_redirect(), allow-lists.
  • Safe quick-fixes only where they cannot change who can reach your code.

Project report

Tools | Kassi WP Security Report writes deterministic Markdown and JSON reports (rule, CWE, file:line, code, CVE references). They are ready for code review, CI artifacts and compliance evidence.

Deterministic and offline

No network calls and no telemetry. One plugin version gives the same result everywhere. New rules arrive with plugin updates. Teams can also commit an optional rule pack (same YAML format) to their repository: Settings | Tools | Kassi WordPress Security.

The rules are open (CC BY 4.0): kassi-wp-rules. WordPress is a trademark of the WordPress Foundation. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by it.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0: first release. Thirteen inspections (WP-001 to WP-013), project report (Markdown and JSON), path exclusions and an optional project rule pack.
